**A beta, for owners who want to help test.** It ships inside
[HMG-API 1.1.0-beta.1](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.1.0-beta.1), and
you can also install it on its own over 2.1.0 (HMG-API 1.0.0 or later). The first release
from this repository; the mod's id is still `wireless-carplay-aa`, so it updates 2.1.0 in
place.

## What's new since 2.1.0

- **CarPlay turns on the cluster and HUD, fixed for more maneuvers.** Ordinary left, right
  and straight turns showed nothing when the phone didn't send an exit angle, or on
  left-hand-traffic routes. They now show. At the start of a route the previous route's
  arrow is cleared. (HMG-API#15)
- **Lanes only from the phone.** While the phone guides, the car's own navigation kept
  sending the lanes of every intersection, none marked, over the phone's real lanes for the
  next turn. Now only the phone's lanes show. (#4)
- **New setting: "Android Auto turns in the car's own format (AR HUD arrow, distance
  bar)"**, off by default. Near each maneuver (about 1,500 ft) Android Auto's turns go to the
  cluster and HUD as the car's own navigation sends them, with the distance bar counting
  down, which the AR HUD animates. Off: the projection icons, as before. Checked on a US
  Ioniq 5 with the AR HUD. Takes effect when the head unit restarts. (#4)
- **No more loading spinner with Android Auto at roundabouts.** Google Maps and Waze showed
  the right turn up to a roundabout, then a spinner until the next instruction. The
  roundabout's exit now stays on the cluster and HUD, with the icons the car's own
  navigation uses; turns ahead get real icons instead of the spinner. (#11)

## What to test

- Wireless CarPlay and wireless Android Auto still connect, play audio and take calls.
- Turn-by-turn on the cluster and HUD with CarPlay (Apple Maps, Google Maps) and Android Auto
  (Google Maps, Waze): ordinary turns, roundabouts, lanes before a turn.
- If your car has the AR HUD: the new setting, on and off (restart the head unit after
  changing it).

## Known issues

- Left-hand-traffic roundabouts and "Recalculating…" during a reroute with Android Auto
  aren't in this beta (#12).
- Not in this beta either: keeping Bluetooth up during wireless CarPlay (#2), the CarPlay
  picture recovering from a freeze (#3), the AR HUD notes (#10).
- The US Ioniq 5 (2023 on) on 260903 isn't in the mod's car list yet, so it says "isn't for
  this head unit"; install anyway works at your own risk.

## Going back

HMG-API doesn't install an older version over a newer one from the app, so: remove the mod
in the HMG-API app and apply, then put `wireless-carplay-aa-2.1.0.zip` from
[HMG-API 1.0.2](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.2) in
`HMGAPI/updates/` on a USB stick and Check USB updates. Over adb, `hmgapid engine install
<zip> --force` installs it directly.

## Reporting

An [issue here](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/issues/new/choose) with
your car, head unit software (e.g. 260507), HMG-API version and this mod's version, what
the phone and navigation app were, and a Car Report from the HMG-API app if you can.
